running.title: SANOVA is running
running.body: Close the game before installing updates or changing mods.

setUp.title: Let's get SANOVA ready
setUp.body: Point the launcher at your copy of GTA San Andreas to begin.

fixGame.title: Your game needs attention
fixGame.body: Open My game to see what's wrong and how to fix it.

resume.title: Installation paused
resume.body: Pick up where you left off. Nothing is downloaded twice.

updateLauncher.title: Launcher update needed
updateLauncher.body: SANOVA {version} needs a newer version of this launcher.

repair.title: Some files need repair
repair.body: Verification found missing or changed files.
repair.pending: An earlier change was interrupted. Repair restores a consistent installation.

notConfigured.title: SANOVA isn't published yet
notConfigured.body: This launcher build has no download source configured. Releases will appear here once they're published.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Connect to the internet to download SANOVA.

noRelease.title: No release available yet
noRelease.body: There's no SANOVA release on the {channel} channel yet.

ledger.gameHint: Choose your GTA San Andreas folder

welcome.title: Welcome to SANOVA
welcome.body: SANOVA brings a modernized San Andreas to your own copy of the game. This launcher sets everything up, keeps it updated and starts the game for you.
welcome.note: You need GTA San Andreas for PC installed on this computer. SANOVA installs into its own folder and never changes your original game.

game.title: Find your copy of GTA San Andreas
game.body: We looked in the usual places. Choose the installation SANOVA should use as its starting point.
game.definitive: This is the Definitive Edition, a different game that SANOVA can't use.
game.noneTitle: We couldn't find GTA San Andreas automatically
game.noneBody: Choose the folder that contains gta_sa.exe.
game.pickTitle: Choose your GTA San Andreas folder
game.existingBody: These folders already contain SANOVA. Use one to continue where you left off.

ok.title: Your game is compatible
ok.body: Everything SANOVA needs is in place.

warnings.title: Compatible, with a few notes
warnings.body: SANOVA can be installed. Review the notes below first.

override.title: Unsupported, continuing at your own risk
override.body: You allowed unsupported game versions in Settings. SANOVA may not work correctly.

blocked.title: This installation can't be used
blocked.body: The problems below need to be solved before SANOVA can be installed.

location.title: Where should SANOVA be installed?
location.body: SANOVA gets its own folder. Your original game stays exactly as it is.
location.existing: This folder contains a SANOVA installation. Setup will continue it.
location.space: Needs about {required}. {free} free on this drive.
location.note: Use a short folder name with plain letters. The 2005 game can't start from folders whose names contain characters outside your Windows language.

components.title: Choose optional mods
components.body: Required parts are always installed. You can change these later on the Mods page.

review.title: Ready to install
review.notConfigured: SANOVA content hasn't been published yet, so nothing can be installed now. Your choices are saved and Home will offer to install as soon as a release is available.
review.offline: You're offline, so SANOVA can't be downloaded right now. Your choices are saved for later.
review.unavailable: No SANOVA release is available right now. Your choices are saved for later.
review.savesNote: Your saved games are backed up before anything changes.

game.title: My game
game.lede: Your original GTA San Andreas, the SANOVA installation built from it, and your saved games.

install.title: SANOVA installation
install.noneBody: Run setup to choose your game and an install folder.
install.verifiedIssues: Problems found {when}. Run a repair to fix them.

saves.title: Saved games
saves.lede: GTA San Andreas keeps saves in your Documents folder, shared by every copy of the game. The launcher backs them up before it changes anything.
saves.noFolder: The saves folder doesn't exist yet. It's created the first time you save in the game.

edition.modified: Executable modified by a third party

detect.rockstar: Found through the Rockstar Games Launcher

folder_missing.title: The folder doesn't exist
folder_missing.body: Choose the folder where GTA San Andreas is installed.

folder_is_sanova.title: This is a SANOVA installation
folder_is_sanova.body: Choose your original GTA San Andreas folder instead. SANOVA is built from a copy of it.

folder_no_access.title: The folder can't be read
folder_no_access.body: Windows denied access to the game files. Check the folder's permissions.

definitive_edition.title: This is the Definitive Edition
definitive_edition.body: GTA San Andreas – The Definitive Edition is a separate game. SANOVA needs the original 2005 PC version.

exe_missing.title: No game executable found
exe_missing.body: The folder doesn't contain gta_sa.exe. Choose the folder where the game is installed.

exe_rerelease.title: Steam / Rockstar Games Launcher version
exe_rerelease.body: This is the 2014 re-release (version 3.0 or later). Its executable was changed in ways that break the mods SANOVA uses. SANOVA needs the original version 1.0.

exe_retail_unrecognized.title: Unrecognized retail version
exe_retail_unrecognized.body: This copy-protected executable isn't in the list of known versions. It may be version 1.01 or a regional release that SANOVA hasn't been tested with.

exe_unknown.title: Unrecognized executable
exe_unknown.body: This executable doesn't match any known GTA San Andreas version. It may have been modified.

exe_supported.title: Version {version} ({region}) recognized
exe_supported.body: This is the original executable SANOVA is built for.

exe_modified.title: Modified executable
exe_modified.body: This executable was modified by a third party. SANOVA is tested with the original version 1.0, so stability isn't guaranteed.

exe_unverified.title: Version {version} ({region}) isn't verified
exe_unverified.body: SANOVA hasn't been tested with this version yet. It may still work.

exe_unsupported.title: Version {version} isn't supported
exe_unsupported.body: SANOVA needs the original version 1.0 of the game executable.

exe_disc_check.title: The game may ask for its disc
exe_disc_check.body: The original retail executable has copy protection that can ask for the game DVD when it starts.

files_missing.title: Game files are missing
files_missing.body: Some files from the original game aren't there. The installation may be incomplete; reinstalling from the original disc usually fixes this.

files_modified.title: Some game files were changed
files_modified.body: These original files differ from a clean installation, probably because of earlier mods. SANOVA copies them as they are.

mods_detected.title: Your game folder contains mods
mods_detected.body: SANOVA works best on a clean installation. These files will be copied along with the game.

mods_detected_filtered.title: Your game folder contains mods
mods_detected_filtered.body: Only original game files are copied into the SANOVA folder. These mods stay where they are and aren't carried over.

mods.title: Mods
mods.lede: Choose which optional parts of SANOVA are installed. Required parts keep the experience consistent.
mods.requiredTip: Part of the core experience; always installed.

cascade.disabled: Also disabled because it depends on it

source.external: Downloaded from the author's own site.
source.manual: You'll download this from the author's page; the launcher will tell you where.

empty.title: No mod list yet
empty.body: The list of SANOVA components appears after the launcher has found a release.

notConfigured.title: SANOVA isn't published yet
notConfigured.body: Once a release is available, its components will appear here.

activity.title: Downloads
activity.lede: What the launcher is doing now, what it did recently, and the files it keeps for resuming downloads.
activity.idleBody: Installs, updates and repairs show their progress here.

cache.title: Download cache
cache.body: Partly downloaded packages are kept so an interrupted install can resume. Turn on Keep downloaded packages in Settings to keep finished ones too.
cache.clearBody: Downloaded packages will be removed. A paused installation would have to download them again.

updates.title: Updates
updates.lede: SANOVA and the launcher update independently.

channel.title: Release channel
channel.body: Beta releases arrive earlier and may be less stable.

launcher.title: Launcher
launcher.restartBody: The launcher closes, installs the update and opens again.

notConfigured.title: Launcher updates aren't set up
notConfigured.body: This build doesn't have a release source configured yet.

devBuild.title: Development build
devBuild.body: This copy wasn't installed with the SANOVA installer, so it can't update itself.

failed.title: Couldn't check for launcher updates
failed.body: Check your connection and try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: Changes are saved as you make them.

theme.title: Theme
theme.body: Dark suits the game. Light works better in bright rooms.

installPath.title: SANOVA folder
installPath.locked: SANOVA is installed here. Uninstall it to choose a different folder.

afterLaunch.title: When the game starts
afterLaunch.body: What the launcher does after starting SANOVA.

arguments.title: Launch options
arguments.body: Extra command-line options passed to the game. Leave empty unless a guide tells you otherwise.

backupSaves.title: Back up saves before changes
backupSaves.body: Copy your saved games before installing, updating, repairing or changing mods.

parallel.title: Simultaneous downloads
parallel.body: More can be faster on a fast connection.

speed.title: Download speed limit
speed.body: Leave room for other things using your connection.

keepCache.title: Keep downloaded packages
keepCache.body: Makes repairs faster and works offline, but uses more disk space.

checkContent.title: Check for SANOVA updates at start
checkContent.body: Looks for new releases each time the launcher opens.

checkLauncher.title: Check for launcher updates at start
checkLauncher.body: Looks for a newer launcher each time it opens.

verbose.title: Detailed logging
verbose.body: Writes more information to the log files. Useful when reporting a problem.

unsupported.title: Allow unsupported game versions
unsupported.body: Install SANOVA even when your game version isn't supported. Expect crashes.
unsupported.confirmBody: SANOVA is built for GTA San Andreas version 1.0. Other versions can crash or behave strangely, and problems with them can't be supported.

developer.title: Developer mode
developer.body: Shows tools for testing SANOVA releases, such as a custom content source.

source.title: Content source
source.body: Overrides where SANOVA releases come from. For testing builds made with sanova-manifest.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.lede: Checks the launcher, your game and your SANOVA installation. If something's wrong, export a report and attach it when asking for help.
diagnostics.exportedBody: Personal details such as your Windows user name have been removed.

diag.os_old: {os} is older than Windows 10 and isn't supported.
diag.settings_recovered: The settings file was damaged and has been reset.
diag.install_path_not_ansi: {path} contains characters the game can't handle.
diag.transaction_pending: An interrupted change will be recovered.
diag.install_damaged: {issues} of {files} files are missing or changed.
diag.install_state_corrupt: The installation record can't be read.
diag.launcher_source_not_configured: No launcher release source configured yet.

about.license: Open-source software under the Apache License 2.0
about.body: SANOVA is a community project that modernizes the 2005 PC release of Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas while keeping its character: better visuals, fixes, atmosphere and stability, installed into your own copy of the game.
about.disclaimer: SANOVA is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas are trademarks of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. You need your own legally obtained copy of the game; SANOVA does not distribute it.

op.busyBody: Wait for the current task to finish, or cancel it on the Downloads page.

closeBusy.title: Stop and close the launcher?
closeBusy.body: The current task will be stopped. Anything half-applied is undone, and downloads continue from where they stopped next time.
closeBusy.wait: The current task can't be interrupted safely. The launcher will close as soon as it finishes.

gameRunning.title: Close the game first
gameRunning.body: GTA San Andreas is running. Close it, then try again.

incompatible.title: Your game isn't compatible
incompatible.body: Open My game to see what's wrong and how to fix it.

launcherTooOld.title: Update the launcher first
launcherTooOld.body: This SANOVA release needs a newer launcher. Open Updates to get it.

manual.title: Download {name}
manual.body: This mod's author doesn't allow it to be redistributed, so download {file} from the author's page, then choose the downloaded file.

body.one: {count} file is still missing or changed.
body.other: {count} files are still missing or changed.

uninstall.title: Uninstall SANOVA?
uninstall.body: Files SANOVA installed in {path} will be removed. Your original game and your saved games aren't touched. Files you added or changed yourself are kept.

body.one: {count} file you added or changed was left in {path}.
body.other: {count} files you added or changed were left in {path}.

restore.title: Restore these saves?
restore.body: Your current saves are backed up first, then replaced with the backup from {date}.

recoveryFailed.title: An interrupted change couldn't be recovered
recoveryFailed.body: Run Verify files on the My game page, then repair if needed.

installPaused.title: Installation paused
installPaused.body: Press Resume on Home to continue. Downloaded files are kept.

uninstalled.title: SANOVA uninstalled
uninstalled.body: Your original game and saved games are untouched.

noSaves.title: No saved games to back up

recovered.title: An interrupted change was undone
recovered.body: The launcher closed during a change last time, so it restored the previous state.

settingsReset.title: Settings were reset
settingsReset.body: The settings file was damaged. A copy was kept in the launcher data folder.

error.unexpected: Something unexpected went wrong. The details below help when reporting it.
error.path_unsafe: This path can't be used. Choose a folder with a short, ordinary name.
error.path_not_writable: Windows doesn't allow writing to this folder. Choose another one, for example C:\Games\SANOVA.
error.path_inside_game: Choose a folder outside your original game folder. SANOVA keeps the original untouched.
error.path_not_empty: This folder already contains files. Choose an empty or new folder.
error.path_system_folder: This is a system or user folder. Choose a dedicated folder, for example C:\Games\SANOVA.
error.path_not_ansi: The folder name has characters the 2005 game can't handle. Use plain letters, for example C:\Games\SANOVA.
error.disk_space: Not enough free space. SANOVA needs about {required}, but only {available} is free.
error.game_incompatible: The selected game installation isn't compatible.
error.game_exe_missing: The game executable is missing from the SANOVA folder. Run a repair.
error.game_launch_elevation: The game asked for administrator rights. Check the executable's compatibility settings.
error.manifest_invalid: The release information is damaged or invalid, so nothing was installed.
error.manifest_schema: This SANOVA release needs a newer launcher. Update the launcher first.
error.manifest_signature_invalid: The release information failed its signature check and was rejected for your safety.
error.manifest_signature_missing: The release information isn't signed, so it was rejected.
error.launcher_too_old: This SANOVA release needs launcher {required} or newer.
error.source_not_configured: No download source is configured yet.
error.source_unreachable: The download server can't be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.source_rate_limited: GitHub is limiting requests from your network for a while. Try again after {resetAt}.
error.source_no_release: No release was found at the download source.
error.source_http_error: The download server answered with an error (HTTP {status}).
error.source_insecure: The download address isn't secure, so it was refused.
error.download_failed: The download didn't complete. Your progress is kept; try again to resume.
error.download_hash_mismatch: A downloaded file was damaged and has been discarded. Try again.
error.download_size_mismatch: A downloaded file has the wrong size and has been discarded. Try again.
error.archive_invalid: A downloaded package is damaged. Try again.
error.archive_unsafe_entry: A package contained an unsafe file path and was rejected.
error.archive_entry_missing: A package is missing a file it should contain.
error.archive_too_large: A package contained more data than expected and was rejected.
error.not_installed: SANOVA isn't fully installed in this folder.
error.install_busy: Another change is still in progress.
error.install_locked: Another program is using the SANOVA folder. Close other launcher windows and try again.
error.install_state_corrupt: The installation record is damaged. Uninstall and install again.
error.rollback_failed: A failed change couldn't be fully undone. Restart the launcher to finish recovery, then verify the files.
error.base_source_missing: An original game file is unavailable: {path}. Make sure your original game folder is still in place.
error.manual_download_required: {component} has to be downloaded manually first.
error.file_verification_failed: A file failed verification: {file}. Try again.
error.component_dependency: The selected mods don't fit together: {detail}
error.component_conflict: Two selected mods can't be used together.
error.component_required: A required component can't be turned off.
error.saves_backup_failed: Your saves couldn't be backed up, so nothing was changed: {detail}
error.file_in_use: A file is in use by another program: {path}. Close it and try again.
